info.name: Incident Management Security Detection Events API
List Events related to a Detection

params.name: detectionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the detection.

items.docs:
Get a list of events related to a security detection.

If more than 1000 events are related to the given detection, then the 1000 most recent
events are returned. This endpoint does not presently support paging using the `Range` header.
